knownWarning.note: Historical push output reported this Dependabot warning. These counts are preserved for audit history and must not be treated as the current open-alert state.

retiredManifestQuarantine.note: Retired archive dependency files are preserved under non-manifest names so GitHub does not treat them as active package manifests after rescan.

runtimeCritical.description: Alerts affecting production runtime packages or build output. Must be identified from Dependabot package metadata before upgrades begin.

order: Patch one minimal dependency batch at a time.

Run npm run dependency:risk:posture and npm run verify after each batch.
Regenerate sanitized audit artifacts before committing.
